item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME
Last Update: 6:38 am EDT Sep 9, 2026


Small Craft Advisory

Today: E wind around 10 kt becoming SSE in the afternoon. Mostly cloudy. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Tonight: S wind 15 to 20 kt, with gusts as high as 25 kt. Showers, with thunderstorms also possible after 2am. Seas 3 ft building to 6 ft.

Thursday: SW wind 15 to 20 kt. A chance of showers before 9am. Seas 5 to 6 ft.

Thursday Night: NW wind around 10 kt. Mostly cloudy. Seas 3 to 4 ft.

Friday: NW wind around 10 kt becoming W in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Friday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Mostly clear. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday: NW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming S in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 2 ft.

Saturday Night: SSW wind around 10 kt. Partly cloudy. Seas around 2 ft.

Sunday: SSW wind 10 to 15 kt. Mostly sunny. Seas around 3 ft.
